official_sources.completion_basis: In-app-browser all-type newest-first pages 1 and 2, 20 unique primary cards each; dates verified down to November 18. PNAS 123/46–49 checked, with November 20 window DOI set exactly matching across search and the related public issues. Earlier guard title and type checked against prior bound browser evidence for the same DOI and date.

limitations: Coverage is relative to enumerated sources at retrieval time; missing or later deposits remain possible.
Descending directories are traversed from their first page to an earlier-than-window guard page; full annual directories are not claimed.
Publisher access failures, unverified dates/identities, and pending journals prevent a selected-run completeness claim.
No later recheck for delayed deposits; no content relevance or type screening.
